defs.def: an investigation of the opinions, behaviour, etc. of a particular group of people, which is usually done by asking them questions 民意调查；民意测验

ex.s: A survey found that 29 percent of college students registered for online courses.
ex.t: 一项调查发现，29%的大学生注册了在线课程。

ex.s: Participation in a post-visit survey is required.
Take a survey after the visit.
"Ding" Darling, a political cartoonist from Des Moines, Iowa, who at that time was appointed by President Franklin Roosevelt as Director of the Bureau of Biological Survey.
ex.t: "丁"·达林(英語：Ding),艾奥瓦州得梅因斯的政治漫画家，他当时被总统富兰克林·罗斯福任命为生物调查局局长。

ex.s: And guess what almost half of the surveyed kids said they do before bedtime?
ex.t: 而且，你猜近一半受访的孩子说他们睡前会做什么？

ex.s: What is the new National Sleep Foundation survey on?
ex.t: 新的国家睡眠基金会的调查是关于什么的？

ex.s: Do a survey and write up the survey results.
We hope that the results of our survey will be useful to the school in deciding what new sports clubs should be set up.
ex.t: 我们希望，我们的调查结果将有助于学校决定应设立哪些新的体育俱乐部。

ex.s: But the new National Sleep Foundation survey found that 35% of 10- to 12-year-olds get only seven or eight hours.
ex.t: 但新的国家睡眠基金会调查发现，35%的10至12岁儿童每晚睡眠不足推荐时间。

ex.s: They surveyed several hundred park-goers, asking them to submit a written summary online of a meaningful interaction they had with nature in the park.
ex.t: 他们调查了数百名公园游客，要求他们在线提交一份书面摘要，描述他们在公园里与大自然的某种有意义互动。

ex.s: EXAMPLE This week, our group of five students did a survey of our classmates to find out what sports interests and needs our students have.
ex.t: ExAMPLE 本周，我们这五个学生组对我们的同学进行了调查，以了解我们的学生对体育的兴趣和需求。

ex.s: A survey of scientists found that extreme weather events, food insecurity, and freshwater shortages might create global collapse.
ex.t: 一项针对科学家的调查发现，极端天气事件、粮食不安全和淡水短缺可能引发全球崩溃。

defs.def: the act of examining and recording the measurements, features, etc. of an area of land in order to make a map or plan of it 测量；勘测；测绘

ex.s: I can reach the ice with our survey tools.
ex.t: 我可以用我们的测量工具到达冰层。

defs.def: an examination of the condition of a house, etc., usually done for sb who is thinking of buying it （尤指为欲购房者所做的）房屋鉴定
a general study, view or description of sth 总体研究；全面评述；概述
to look carefully at the whole of sth, especially in order to get a general impression of it 查看；审视；审察
to study and give a general description of sth 总体研究；全面评述；概述
to measure and record the features of an area of land, for example in order to make a map or in preparation for building 测量；勘测；测绘

ex.s: As a major breakthrough for China in the field of astronomy, its key functions are to survey neutral hydrogen in space, observe pulsars and track and communicate with spacecraft.
ex.t: 作为中国在天文学领域的重大突破，它的关键功能是勘测太空中的中性氢、观测脉冲星以及与航天器进行跟踪和通信。

defs.def: to examine a building to make sure it is in good condition （对建筑物的）鉴定，检查
to investigate the opinions or behaviour of a group of people by asking them a series of questions （对 … ）做民意调查，进行民意测验
